enabled.description: Whether the feature flag is enabled in this environment.

defaultValue.description: The default value returned to users who do not match any targeting condition.

conditions.description: The list of targeting conditions that determine which users receive specific flag values.

seed.description: Random seed value used in percentage based (split) configurations to avoid statistical bias when selecting the flag value.

stickinessProperty.description: Name of the Custom Property that will be used to ensure consistent flag evaluations for percentage based  (split) configurations.

variantsEnabled.description: Whether multivariate variants are enabled for this flag configuration.

resourceId.description: The unique identifier of the resource this configuration belongs to.

cascUrl.description: The CloudBees CasC (Configuration as Code) URL associated with this flag configuration.

created.description: The date and time when this flag configuration was created.

updated.description: The date and time when this flag configuration was last updated.

google.protobuf.ListValue.description:
`ListValue` is a wrapper around a repeated field of values.

 The JSON representation for `ListValue` is JSON array.

google.protobuf.Value.description: Represents a dynamically typed value which can be either null, a number, a string, a boolean, a recursive struct value, or a list of values.
